prompt:
Create ONE landscape 16:9 story illustration for a game, a FIRST STYLE TEST, not a collage.
References 1 and 2 are STYLE ONLY: cozy handmade illustrated storybook, simple whimsical shapes, soft pastel lavender dusk, warm butter yellow and muted orange, visible paper grain and uneven colored pencil/gouache texture, sparse background and imperfect outlines. Look like an enthusiastic beginner lovingly drawing a storybook, modest anatomy and simple irregular hands. All elements must use this same unpolished illustrated language. Not cinematic concept art, not glossy anime, no realistic materials, no ornate high-detail scenery.
References 3 and 4 show the SAME character TZMIL, IDENTITY ONLY. Translate her recognizable design into that simple storybook language: young adult female goddess, pale gray human face with dark eyes, short straight black hair, big fan of dark teal/black feathers with a few small ivory skulls at the base, black sleeveless short dress with simplified ivory ribcage and spine motifs, ivory bone motifs on limbs, dark stockings, a thick muted green and ochre intertwined serpent belt, small ochre boots. Human face, NOT pumpkin, NOT a skull face, NOT bird face. Don't copy the 3D pose, rendering or anatomy complexity.
Scene: Tzmil the affectionate younger sister is guarding a volcano from its summit, kneeling beside a simple squat telescope on a tripod, gently leaning toward the eyepiece and resting one hand affectionately over her chest. Warm little smile. Feathers clearly visible above her head, face seen in three-quarter view. Large figure occupying left/central foreground, not tiny. On the right a rounded dark lavender volcanic crater with a thin warm coral-orange lava glow, a winding tiny path down to a faraway patch of simple green land. A few softly shaped cream clouds and little yellow star shapes. Quiet magical storybook mood, tender and gently funny, not threatening. Flat simplified composition, only a handful of big shapes, slightly awkward naive proportions. Keep head, torso and telescope in upper/middle three quarters so bottom quarter can later hold a dialogue box. No lettering, no captions, no panels, no borders. No other characters or trains in this first sample.
status: First sample awaiting user style feedback; not imported into campaign.
